items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He got a band together, we started rehearsing... he started rehearsing us... we would go up to his place, and he would talk to us

items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Old Man Young sent for us again -- ha! He sent for all of us to come back on the show.

ctx.x: He had a band, too -- a show of his, right?
Yeah, he had the same kind of show Old Man Young had.
But Wilbur and Sidney, Jr. were not in the band at that time, right?
